---
name: Bug report
about: Report a problem with the ISO/IEC 29100 LinkML schema or its artefacts
title: "[Bug] "
labels: bug
---

**Describe the bug**
A clear description of what went wrong.

**Where?**
The schema element, generated artefact (`project/...`) or release asset involved. A problem in ISO/IEC 29100 itself belongs with [ISO/IEC JTC 1/SC 27](https://www.iso.org/committee/45306.html), through your national standards body.

**To reproduce**
Steps to reproduce the behavior, including the exact command and input data.

**Expected behavior**
What you expected to happen, and the clause of ISO/IEC 29100:2024 that says so, if any. Cite it by number, and do not quote it.

## Environment

- OS:
- Python version (`uv run python --version`):
- `iso29100` release, or the commit you built from:
- LinkML version (`uv run linkml --version`):

**Additional context**
Logs, tracebacks, or validation output.

## AI Assistance

If you used AI tools while preparing this issue, you are still the author and responsible for understanding, verifying, and defending your submission. Don't dump LLM output into this issue without curation. See the [AI Covenant](https://github.com/lmodel/iso29100/blob/main/AI_COVENANT.md) for details.
